verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a code-first orchestration framework (graphs, nodes, edges, checkpointers, CLI for running a server) with no evidence of any natural-language command interface for operating the product itself — developers configure and run it via Python/JS APIs and CLI flags, not NL prompts. Missing for 10: any documented chat/NL interface, NL-driven graph builder, or NL-based CLI/administration capability.
